full_judgment: 13. The only benefit that the Act of 2005 gives to the existing teachers and officers etc. is a choice for them to continue on deputation for upto 5 (five) years on condition that during their Academic career they did not have any 3rd class qualification. The law also gives them the benefit of relaxing the age qualification and retaining their salary scale if they apply for any post in the University. There is also a further qualification that they must have first class at graduate or post graduate level, which would not be a requirement if he/she held a PhD. or M. Phil or equivalent decree.
